tei:div.tei:p: "$ (151)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dwags po snyan brgyud lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen sdom pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(152)༄༅// gu ru ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ na mā mi/ dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs can baiḍū'i lang tsho 'bar// chos kun gnyis su mi phyed khyab cing rtag pa'i sku// bde chen thig le gcig tu phrin las lhun rdzogs pa// khyab bdag bla ma'i ngo bo he ru ka dpal zhabs la 'dud/ grub pa'i snyan brgyud las byung zhing*// man ngag rang bzos ma bslad pa// skal ldan rjes bzung dbang bskur bcas// dkyil 'khor cho ga gsal bar dgod// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod nas slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i rim pa rtsa ba'i gzhung las bla med spyi dang mthun par rgya cher gsungs kyang 'dir dkyus su lag len bya sla ba'i ched du dgos don snying por dril ba la/ thog mar sa brtag slong sbyong srung gi skor rnams sgrub gnas rnying pa dang ras bris dkyil 'khor la mi dgos pas ma smos// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bzhengs grub na de dag gi phyag len snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang gi phyag len thugs kyi 'khor lo'i pod du bzhugs pa las shes par bya'o// 'dir 'chad par bya ba la gsum/ dang po sta gon/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi/ gsum pa rjes tshogs mchod sogs bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po sta gon la bzhi yod pa las/ sa'i lha mo sta gon bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ldangs bcas sngon tu btang nas/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhir maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu (153 )gcig dgod/ de'i mdun du sa lha'i gtor ma dkar zlum dang*/ mthar mchod pas bskor ba bshams nas/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su lām̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa/

gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs par gyur/ ces bsams te lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya sa la lan gsum rdeb pa dang mnyam du/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil bcas// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' yis ni// skad cig nyid la 'dir spyon cig /oṃ laṃ bā su dhā ri dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ pṛ thī wī de wī pra wa ra sat+kā ra/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ār+ghaṃ gyi mal du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa ma naṃ/ prok+ṣaṇaṃ/ puṃṣ+pe nas/ shab+da 'i bar rnams (154 )bcug pas mchod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang spyi ltar byin gyis brlab pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi brlabs nas/ mdun gyi lha mo'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas dgyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ laṃ bā su dhā ri ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// sku phyed thon te gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// bum pa dam bca'i phyag rgya can// khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste// sa 'og gtso mo khyod la 'dud// ces bstod nas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin ma la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa la/ lha mos/ kyai/ rig pa 'dzin pa ji ltar dgyes pa bzhin du mdzod cig

/ces gnang ba byin par gyur/ de la gtang rag gi tshul du/ oṃ pṛ thī wī de wi sogs kyis gong ltar mchod/ zhes mchod pas dgyes te dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la thim par gyur/ ces bsam/ gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ bsang gtor dang dri bzang gi chus gtor ba'i gzhir slob dpon gyis gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying lan gsum gsum brjod de dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ he ru ka bzhi'i sngags brjod de phyogs bzhir zlum por byas par las rdor gyis me tog gi tshum bu re dgod/ de'i mdun du gtor ma dang*/ mtha' mchod pas bskor te/ bsang sbyang*/ oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snod bcud thams cad stong bar gyur/ ces pa nas/ lte ba mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba bh+rūm̐ dkar po sogs nas/ rang rig dang*/ bdag nyid zer ba dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba sogs dor nas/ gsal bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang*/ bsnyen dmigs dang sngags (155 )bzla ba rnams dor bas bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ spro na mchod bstod mdun bskyed ltar byas te/ rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo he ru ka /phag mor lhan cig yang dag ldan// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas// nangs par dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bgyi// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par gyur/ u t+tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs pa nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam mo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyi brab/ bum rdzas so lnga btab pa chas dang ldan pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis ka rtsa ba dang nag po med pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ kha g.yel ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ de'i nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ lcags kyu lnga/ sgron ma lnga rnams dang*/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus yongs su gang ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang bam̐ dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug dmar po bam̐ dmar pos mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i zhes pa nas rang rig dang*/ bdag nyid zer ba dor te/ ye shes rdo rje mthing ga (156)rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ las bum gyi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du bam̐ las khaṇ+ḍa ro hī nī dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ bum mtshan rnams kyang rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rdo rje bzhi'i lha tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes pa nas/ dbur brgyan par gyur/ bar dang*/ las bum gyi lha la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar ram/ spro na mdun bskyed ltar byas nas gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ gzungs thag la brgyud nas bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa khengs par gyur/

ces bsams la rnam rgyal gyi lha la lha lnga'am/ spro na 'khor sngags rnams gsum re tsam dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar byas la yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dung zhal gyi chus mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum pa'i lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces bsam/ las thams cad pa'i lhas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces brjod de yig brgya bzla'o// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma rnams la sgo nyung ngu khus byas phyag 'tshal gral du 'khod pa la sbyor ba gsum spyi ltar byed pa dang srung 'khor sgom pa'ang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes su bzhugs pas spro na spyi ltar byas nas/ kun slong bcos pa dang chos bshad ci rigs byas mthar/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir byon no cog gi lo tsā zhig la mkhas grub chos brgyud 'gro don gang thad nas 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba rje lho brag mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros zhes grags (157)pa de nyid kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lan gsum/ bal por lan bzhi ste/ rgya gar dang bal po'i yul du lan bdun byon/ dpal nā ro pa chen pos thog drangs pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma brgya dang bcu gnyis/ brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ gzhan rig mngon par shes pa'i bla ma bcu gsum/ khyad par grub thob zhe lnga/ rje 'gran gyi do med nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis kyi drung du lo hril po bcu dgu'i bar du bzhugs/ khyad par du'ang dpal nā ro pa chen po lo drug zla ba bdun gyi bar du sku'i grib ma ltar 'bral med du bsten nas thugs dam dgyes pa rdo rjes thog drangs rgyud dang man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan pa'i tshul rnams rdo rje'i mgur las 'byung ba ltar lags/

khyad par bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud ces brgyud pa mang po'i bar du gcig brgyud kyi rgyas btab pa 'di nyid grub chen tai lo pa chen pos o rgyan gsang ba'i pho brang du rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la zhus pa'i tshe sku gsung thugs kyi brda gsum bstan te yid bzhin nor bu skor gsum gyi smin grol gdams ngag stsal ba rnams dpal nā ro pa chen po kho na la gnang*/ rje mar pa rgya gar du lan gsum byon pa'i rjes mar dpal nā ro pa chen po spyod pa la gshegs zin cing gsol ba btab cing yun ring du btsal bas byang puñtsa ha rir mngon sum du mjal zhing zla ba drug tu bsten pa'i skabs bde mchog yab bka' yum bka' snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ mar ston chen pos slob ma mes rdog mtshur gsum sogs la dgyes gsang gtsos rgyud sde rnams kyi bshad bka' lag len rgyas par gnang*/ bde mchog snyan brgyud skor rje btsun mi la kho na la gcig brgyud du stsal/ mi la ras pa grub pa brnyes skabs snyan brgyud kyi bka' rgya cung zad grol ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan pa ltar ras pa mched brgyad la cha shas (158)re gnang ba'i sgros 'dug kyang gzhan rnams mkha' spyod du byon pa tsam las chos rgyun 'dzin pa 'di byung gi gsal kha mi 'dug /ras chung rdo rje grags par gnang ba la ras chung snyan brgyud ces 'bring po dang*/ dwags po rin po cher gnang ba la dwags po snyan brgyud ces rgyas pa dang*/ ngom rdzong ras par gnang ba la ngom rdzong snyan brgyud ces bsdus par grags pa gsum da lta'i bar du smin grol gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i rgyun ma chad par bzhugs pa las 'dir dwags po rin po ches dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la chig brgyud du gnang*/ de nas brgyud pa bcu gsum par dpal tai lo sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam 'phrul me nyag grub thob rma se blo gros rin chen nyid byon pa dang snyan brgyud kyi bka' grol bar lung bstan pa ltar rje lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pas me nyag grub chen nyid la snyan brgyud rdzogs par gnang*/

des rtogs ldan ya brgyad/ 'ja' mo mi gsum sogs la rdzogs par gnang ba'i gdams skor 'di la nor bu skor gsum gyi nang tshan smin lam yid bzhin nor bu la yab rgyal po lta bu'i smin byed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa las da lam yab 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgo nas dbang bskur bgyid pa yin/ de la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las thog mar sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams re 'bul bar zhu/ de nas nang dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon he ru ka yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma sogs sems can thams cad lha bde mchog tu gyur/ de rnams 'od kyi gong bur zhu ba yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas yum gyi mkhar babs te sras kyi rang bzhin gyi bde mchog sngon po rdor dril 'dzin par gyur pa la/ rgyal ba rab 'byams spyan drangs/ 'od dang bdud rtsir zhu ba spyi gtsug gi gser gyi sgo nas zhugs/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang lhan cig (159)mgrin pa man gyi gnas bzhir babs pas dga' bzhi myong*/ lhan skyes kyi bde ba'i rten du bas pas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes/ mthar yab yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir spros te so so'i gdan la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des ni 'jug pa'i skor rnams nyan pa la dbang bar byas pa dang sras su byas phyir 'di phyin chad bu tshur theg pa chen po las sogs bu zhes 'bod par byed pa yin/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// de nas spro ba bskyed cing nyan par bskul ba ni// bu tshur theg pa chen po las// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya

// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces dang*/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus (160)nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs kyi// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlob// ces gsungs pa'i don ltar dga' spro khyad par can bskyed pa dang*/ nyan par gdams pa'i don ltar rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis nyan par mdzad 'tshal/ de nas bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus pa'i drung du phyag 'tshal ba sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ khyad par byang sdom bzung nas srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*// rgyal sras tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang longs spyod mchod bgyis nas// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang rnams// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal nyan thos 'gro rnams kyis// bsgoms dang bzlas brjod bsod nams gang*// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// bdag gis dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog

/'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// de nas sngags sdom la thun mong ba brtul zhugs nyer lnga po 'dzin cing srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// thun mong brtul zhugs sdom pa ni// (161)srog gcod rdzun du smra ba dang*// gzhan gyi bud med nor 'phrog dang*// chang 'thung myos par mi bgyi'o// rgyan po kha na ma tho'i zas// dam tshig bstan bcos smra ba dang*// mu stegs kla klo'i chos spyod min// dud 'gro byis pa bud med dang*// skyes pa mchod rten bsnun mi bya// dag pa'i grogs dang rje bo dang*// dge 'dun rnams dang rgyal ba dang*// yid gtad rnams la 'khu mi bya// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la// mig sogs dbang po zhen mi bya// nga rgyal tshig rtsub spro thung dang*// phra ma sdig pa'i grogs rnams spang*// phyag rgya mtshan ma grib 'gom min// bya ba ma yin rnam par spang*// kha na ma tho'i las 'di dag /deng nas brtsams te spang bar bgyi// de nas khyed rang slob ma rnams skad cig gis dpal he ru ka sngon po phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba'i skur gyur/ de la slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis dri'i thig le gnas gsum du byas pas dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis rlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes dri'i thig le bya/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ haḥdakar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar dbang*/ phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣaṭa he nag po mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa haṃ ljang gu dpal rta mchog ste/ ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i go chas rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob ma bud med yod na/ lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar po sogs/ so sor dgos par gsung*/ de nas dngos grub kyi skal ba brtag pa la nyin mo dngos su brtag pa dang*/ mtshan mo rmi lam gyis brtag (162)pa gnyis las/ dang po'i slad du so shing sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi phreng ba can slob ma'i dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas so shing dang so shing gi ra ba gnyis char byin gyis brlab/ khyed rang gi kha shar du phyogs pas so shing thal mo sbyar bas zung la so shing gi ra bar sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad de 'dor bar mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ dan+ta sho dha ni hūm̐/ zhes dor/ de yi tshe na mtshan ma ni// de tshe bdag la blta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du bstan gyur na// de yi dngos grub mchog ces bshad// de bzhin shar du bltas na ni// de yi dngos grub 'bring du 'gyur// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten gyi ni dngos grub 'thob// so shing dor ba 'ga' zhig las// gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi /dngos grub de la the tshom med// ces pa bzhin 'byung bas nges par mdzad 'tshal/ brgyud nas rmi lam gyi sgo nas brtag pa la rmi lam gsal ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ las bum gyi chu dung zhal du blugs pa/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzla/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa lan gsum blud pa lan gsum 'thung mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba ཿsarba pā paṃ ni====s+ya saṃ sho dhā ya sarba bi ka wā a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes blud/ de nas rmi lam gyi bar chad bsrung phyir srung skud gdags pa ni/ srung skud dmar po lus tshad sum lte ba la mdud pa gsum btab pa slob ma'i sgo gsum dang rmi lam gyi bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa skyes pa'i dpung ba g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas la btags te/ las sngags brjod cing las bum chu gtor/ mdud steng rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbā na swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas byung ba'i (163)ku sha'i chun po che chung sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa slob ma'i rmi lam mi 'khrug pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ dhīḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa hūm̐/ zhes pas sbyin/ ku sha'i sngas gdan la nyol la rmi lam rtogs shig /de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni 'di la gsan 'tshal/ 'jig rten du na kun mkhyen dag /u dum+bā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur ba na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu gcod// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// dbang thob rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// lam 'dir khyod nyid 'gro gyur pas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i tshig gi don ltar gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba la dga' ba dang spro ba rgya cher skyed mdzod// des sta gon gyi chos rnams grub pa lags/

zhes brjod de bsngo smon byas nas slob ma rnams gyes/ sgrub thabs gsham nas 'byung ba ltar lag mchod/ gtor 'bul/ tshogs mchod rnams bya/ ma lcogs na (164 )gtor 'bul tsam dang sgrub thabs ltar mchod bstod mdor bsdus/ bzod gsol/ lha mgron brtan bzhugs/ bsngo smon shis brjod byas pas 'grub bo/// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dbang don dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ dbus su mañdzi'i steng sngar sta gon byas pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa dung chos gzungs rdor bcas bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du las bum/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ mdun thod chang*/ gsang thod dang rig tsaka /mtha' skor du chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yon skor/ rgyab phyogs su 'bul gtor lugs 'di'i phyag bzhes ltar grub dka' bas bshos zlum gtso 'khor lnga rgyan spros btsos pa bshams/ logs gar bdar gri gug /thod pa/ kha twāṃ/ tshangs skud/ rus pa'i rgyan drug bcas dngos sam tsakli/ snyan brgyud kyi glegs bam/ phreng ba/ dung dkar rnams dang*/ sbyong chas chang bu/ til/ me chu'i snod/ mig dar/ me tog /mig thur/ slob ma mchod pa nyer spyod lnga/ sngon gtor sogs 'du bya/ de nas sgrub thabs kyi dag pa gsum dran pa nas bzung bskyed bzlas dang gsham gyi lhar ldang bar rdzogs par btang*/ de nas bum bskyed bzlas pa sogs gong ltar tshang bar bya/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snod bcud thams cad stong par gyur/ ces pa nas/ lte ba mthing ga yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba bh+rūm̐ dkar po las/ zhes pa nas rang rig dang bdag nyid dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba sogs nas gsal bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar rnams dor bas/

mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes pa'i bar byas nas/ sta gon gyi lha la'ang dmigs te spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ/ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang 'byon pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs dar snang ba// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis (165)dad pas deng 'dir spyan 'dren na// dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ/ brjod dus sta gon gyi lta bang mdun bskyed la thim par dmigs pa bcas kyis/ dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar bya/ dang por thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags mchod ni/ lha re re bzhin gsal btab la sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i sngags rnams brjod/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ oṃ/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi mchod yon mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas khyed la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba wīr yo gi nī badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ/ dag cing dri med= sngags kyi zhal bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu= bzhes nas= sngags thog mtha' sngar ltar la ār+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ sbyar/ oṃ/ dag cing dri med= sngags kyi 'thor 'thung mchog 'di dag /mchog tu= bzhes nas= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= oṃ/ dag cing dri med= sngags kyi zhabs bsil mchog 'di dag /mchog tu= bzhes nas= pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ/ me tog 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra puṣ+pe= nags tshal las byung phan pa yi// dag pa'i dri ldang bdug spos mchog

/bdag gis= bzhes nas= dhū pe= srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gis= bzhes nas= ā lo ke= lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri// tshim byed dag pa'i dri mchog 'di// bdag gis= bzhes nas= gan+dhe= bshos gtsang bza' ba dang bcas pa'i// kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bdag gis= bzhes nas= nai wi d+ya (166)pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u dang*// sgra dbyangs yid 'phrog sna tshogs pa// bdag gis= bzhes nas bdag la= shab+da pra tīts+tsha= khyad par rig ma bcu drug 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badz+ra bī ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu 'bud// rkang pa gsum par= /rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ser// waṃ she= rdo rje lha mo rnga chen brdung*// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar// mṛ taṃ ge= rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga brdung*// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*// mu ra dze= bzhad pa rdo rje lha mo ni// dmar skya phyag gnyis bzhad dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// hā s+ye= sgeg pa rdo rje lha mo ni// sngon mo phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas// rkang pa phyi ma gnyis sngar ltar sbyar te/ lā s+ye= glu yi rdo rje lha mo ni// ser mo ting ting shags dang bcas// gī tī= gar gyi rdo rje lha mo ni// ljang gu phyag gnyis gar dang bcas/ nri t+ye= mdog dkar rdo rje me tog ni// g.yas na me tog cang te'u dang*// g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// puṣ+pe= mdog mthing rdo rje bdug spos ni// g.yas na bdug spos cang te'u dang*// tshig phyi ma gnyis sbyar zhing*/ dhū pe= mdog dmar rdo rje mar me ni// g.yas na mar me cang te'u dang*/ dī pe= mdog ljang rdo rje dri chab ni// g.yas na dri chab cang te'u dang*// gan+dhe=

gzugs kyi rdo rje me long bsnams// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ rū pa badz+ri= ro yi rdo rje 'khar gzhong bsnams// dmar mo sogs gong bzhin te/ /ra sa badz+ri= reg gi rdo rje na bza' bsnams// ljang gu= spar+she badz+ri= chos dbyings rdo rje (167)chos 'byung bsnams// dkar mo= dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal srid ni/ rgyas par na/ lha rdzas las grub sogs nas/ 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// zhes bsgyur ba dang sngags bcas kyis mchod/ bsdu na/ gser gyi 'khor lo nor bu rin po che// btsun mo blon po glang po rta mchog dang*// dmag dpon 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyis// nam mkha' bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// sngags sngar ltar gyi mthar/ sab+ta rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod 'dod yon lnga ni/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes bya ste// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rgyal ba ni// mnga' bdag rdo rje rnam snang mdzad// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba wī ra yo gi nī badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sgra la rnam gsum shes= lha rnams la ni= de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' grags chen po// ru pa'i gnas sa shab+da zhes bcug dri la rnam gsum= lha rnams la ni= de nyid bcom ldan sangs rgyas ni// rin chen phung por rab tu grags// gan+dhe= ro la rnam gsum= lha rnams la ni= de nyid bcom ldan 'dod chags che// rdo rje chos kyis bzhes su gsol// ra sa= reg la rnam gsum= lha rnams la ni= de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// don yod 'bras bu ster ba po// spar+she= zhes dang*/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa ni// tshes bcu dus su chang sna bzhi// shes rab g.yon gyi lag pa la// thabs chen g.yas kyi lag pas mchod// mtshan ldan rdo rje'i ka pā la// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa// pā ni ma skyes skye ba med// la ni blo 'das yid dang bral// sku gsum mi 'gyur ka pā la// zag med bde ba'i chang phung gtams// skye 'chi med pa'i bdud rtsi blugs// yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs// (168)oṃ gyis zag med bdud rtsir gyur// āḥyis skye med bdud rtsir sbyangs// hūm̐ gis blo 'das bdud rtsir spel// lan gsum dkrugs pas bdud rtsi 'dis// pha rol phyin drug lha mo mchod// sa bcu non phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis blang zhing gtor nas/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra= oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ shrī bud+dha he he= karma he he ru= pad+ma he he ru= rat+na he he ru= yum bzhi ni/ ḍā ki nī= lā mye= khaṇ+ḍa ro hi= rū pi ni= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mtheb srin gyis 'thor la 'bul/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rang gis myong*/ gsang mchod ni/ hoḥsrid pa gsum gyi bde rnyed gtso// a la la la la la hoḥ// rgyal ba bde chen dgyes pa'i tshogs// pad+ma la ni rdo rje rol// a la la la la la hoḥ// oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' legs dgyes mchod// ro dang ro mchog thams cad de// dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba rnams// rtag par dngos grub kun la yang*// rol cig rol cig lha mo la// rnal 'byor ma yi thams cad dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje chen po ni// lha mo'i pad+ma rab dgyes rol// hūm̐ a la la la ho dgyes che// bcom ldan 'dod pas dgyes pa khyod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub legs par stsol// pad+ma mchog la dgyes par rol// oṃ a la la ho dgyes pa che// tshogs kyi bde bas dus rtag tu// rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pa yi// pad+ma'i zhal mchog dbye ba yi// pad+ma la ni rol par mdzod// ji ltar bung bas (169)sbrang rtsi bzhin// lha rnams pad+ma nyid la rol// shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms pas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// mchod gnas mchod byed mchod pa rnams// gang tshe sna tshogs mi dmigs pa// de tshe mchod pa chen po ste// rdo rje'i mchod pa zhes brjod do// zhes pa rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pa rkang brgyad ni/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// dbu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung rtse bsnams// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud ka bgegs 'dul mdzad la 'dud/ oṃ/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs kun rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs kun skem zhing pham mdzad ma// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ rgya gzhung nas/ oṃ/ rgyal ba'i sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing*// ram̐ ram̐ rnam 'phrul ut+pal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi// rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcas oṃ oṃ dag dang ldan// tshangs dang lha chen khyab mjug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan mdzad// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ha ha zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pa// mi yi seng ge dregs pa 'joms mdzad 'jigs pa zhabs gnon cing*// a la la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su (170)'dul bar mdzad// cang te'u'i sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug stag gi pags pa bsnams// thugs rjes cher sprul rab khros dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing*// ging ring pho mo zhabs kyis mnan cing sku rtsar rab tu bzhugs// lha rnams mgo la zhabs mnan bde gshegs lnga yi dbu rgyan can// lha rnams thams cad 'khor gyis 'khor lo yongs su bskor mdzad pa// hu lu hu lu dza dzam̐ dzam̐ tram̐ bam̐ rgyu ma thod rlon gyis// phreng ba mdzad cing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs pa'i khros pa yi// glu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad ma// rdo rje chen mo mā ma kis ni sku lus rnam par rgyan// dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyis 'khor lo'i tshogs skrag mdzad// ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgra hi his gnod byed skrag rengs mdzad// brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bam̐ ni pam̐ nis lus la rnam par brgyan// bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni// ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭa kyi mdzad pa can// stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro// phyin ci log dang sdang ba mtha' dag ma lus zhi mdzad cing*// ku lu ku lu dzam̐ dzam̐ yam̐ yam̐ dag gis zhi bar mdzad// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin// bde ba chen po'i mgon khyod mam̐ mam̐ zhes ni mdzad pa can// sems can don du thugs rje chen pos dgyes par mdzad pa po// ā li kā li'i rnal 'byor pa yi sdom pa gsal mdzad cing*// bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gros dam tshig ma lus ston mdzad pa'i// he ru ka dpal brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/

zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing*// snang stong me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// rdo rje he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug tshul gyis gti mug 'joms mdzad cing*// spros bral chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// bud+dha he ru ka la phyag (171)'tshal lo// phrag dog tshul gyis phrag dog 'joms mdzad cing*// phrin las bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// lā ma mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// karma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod chags tshul gyis 'dod chags 'joms mdzad cing*// sna tshogs sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// dum skyes mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// nga rgyal tshul gyis nga rgyal 'joms mdzad cing*// bde chen mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// gzugs can mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// rat+na he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ gi rdo rje las byung char sprin mdog /dga' ba rnam dag drag po'i zhal bzhi ldan// gar gyi nyams dgus gdug pa ma lus 'dul// hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje de la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pa'i sa rnams rdzogs// bcu gnyis phyag gis mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams// yul dang yul can rnam rtog gcod mdzad pa// ngo mtshar mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ gis nga ros srid gsum skrag mdzad cing*// rngams pa'i rkan sgras phaṭa ces sgra sgrogs shing*// bdud dang bgegs tshogs gdug pa ma lus 'dul// rnam rtog bgegs 'dul 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐/ spros bral bde chen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /stong nyid 'od gsal dus gsum bder gshegs yum// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i drwa ba 'joms mdzad pa'i// bde chen rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi rnam dag pa// dag pa'i zhal bzhis rigs kyi yum bzhir rol// dran pa nyer bzhag ye shes bzhi yi dngos// mkha' 'gro ma tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi rnam 'phrul sa bla'i srid pa sbyong*// zhe sdang rnam dag thugs kyi 'khor lor snang*// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// gnas dang nye gnas rnam la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi spros pas sa steng srid (172)pa spyod// 'dod chags rnam dag gsung gi 'khor lor snang*// myu gu can dang sa srung ma la sogs// zhing dang nye zhing bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// sku la rol pas sa 'og srid pa spyod// gti mug rnam dag sku yi 'khor lor snang*// stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can sogs// 'du dang nye 'dur bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol dang dran// bde chen dga' la mos dang gtso la phyogs// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// sgo bzhi'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brtson 'grus rnam dag yang dag spong ba bzhi// gshin rje brtan ma la sogs lha mo rnams// phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa'i sku mdog phyed gzugs zhal// gtso chen mtshams ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen las grub dpag med gzhal yas khang*// byang chub mchog gi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs// gtso bo bde chen thugs kyi snang ba ste// rgyan dang lha mos mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// bder gshegs brgyad ni bstan pa'i snyigs mar 'byung*// bdag med 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad du byung*// byang chub rten du shing brgyad mngon du gyur// 'jig rten chos brgyad bsregs la phyag 'tshal lo//

zhes dpal nā ro pas mdzad pas bstod// sgrub thabs ltar/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje sogs bzlas dmigs bzlas pa bcas ji ltar 'os par byas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma 'jug pa ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs par blangs pa'i mthar bden stobs brjod pa ni/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' che'i rang bzhin// bde mchog 'khor lor bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog yon tan chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog (173)tu bdag grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag grub mdzod// shin tu dga' ba rnams kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher ston pa// rdo rje snyems ma bdag grub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab yin te// 'dod chags mchog gi dam tshig mchog / ces dang*/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor 'dir// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /bden pa 'di yi mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin gnyis med las byung ba// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog

/ de nas sgrub thabs ltar sngags rnams kyis mchod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams la sgo drung du khrus byas phyag 'tshal gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkram bsdu dang*/ kun slong bcos pa chos bshad ci rigs bcas kyis mtshams sbyar te/ 'dir sgra bsgyur mar pa'i thugs bcud bde mchog 'khor lo lha bcu pa dwags po'i snyan brgyud lugs kyi dbang bskur bgyi ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os mtha' dag legs par grub/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor dang*/ zhugs pa la mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i ched du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas (174)snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs/ zhes kha bskang*/ de nas rigs nges par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis 'di skad dris pa'i mos pa mdzod// kyai sdug pa khyod su yin// zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde ba chen por mos pa bdag ni skal pa bzang po'o// de nas 'dun pa nges phyir 'di skad dris pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bu khyod ci zhig 'dod// ces dris pa'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig 'dod de 'tshal lo// til dang me snod chu snod rnams 'du bgyis te/ de nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang mthil du yam̐/ lte bar ram̐/ de'i steng du hūm̐/ snying gar sdig pa'i ngo bo kam̐ nag po rnams sgoms/ rkang mthil gyi yam̐ las rlung g.yos/ ram̐ las me 'bar ba dang*/ de'i steng gi hūm̐ khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas/ snying ga'i kam̐ ded de sna sgo nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa til la thim pa mes bsregs shing*/

chus sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ til me dang chur 'debs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na bha smin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzla/ de nas chang bu mang po la chab bran/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang / a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ bden stobs brjod la bgegs 'gugs/ cha gsum ltar/ gung ka ris bsngo / ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod / gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje'i srung 'khor brtan pos bsrung bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ he ru ka'i cha byad thams cad (175)rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ haḥdakar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hī ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar dbang*/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu dpal rta mchog ste/ ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i go chas rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sngon chad dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mjal ba'i brdar ras yugs dmar po re gdong g.yogs su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu r+bhan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten gyi slad du u dum wā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi chun po kha dog lnga ba re byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ ji skad du/ dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug pa la// gong ma gong ma'i sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste// grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan// thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin// ces gsungs pa ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa 'dzin dgos pas thog mar sdom pa zhu phyir maṇ+ḍal phul/

de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// de nas bla med sngags kyi sems bskyed pa'i slad du// sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i blo dung ba re skyed mdzod/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang lhar gsal ba'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin tu mos mdzod/ de nas chos thams cad spros pa thams cad (176)dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa re gyur par mos la bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ de nyid slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs kyi/ gzhan ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o// khyod kyis ma dad par yang mi bya'o// de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du thun mong ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ des bsdus pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa 'dzin cing srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi sdom pa 'dzin cing srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni// dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni (177)mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// de nas khyad par gyi dam tshig rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang sbom po brgyad de nyer gnyis po rnams 'dzin cing srung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*// de nas gzhal yas khang du 'jug par zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ (178)de nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa'i nyon mongs choms mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pa'i lan du gnang ba sbyin pa ni 'di la gsan 'tshal// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes gnang ba byin nas slob dpon gyis khyed rang he ru kar gsal ba dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas nang du khrid pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ dza hūm̐/ nang du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bzhugs pa rnams la thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar te sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ yang shar sgo'i thad kyi khyams nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta bī ra yo gi ni/ pū dza u pa s+thā na ya/ āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo ga nī/ āt+ma ḍā ki nī/ ādhi tiṣ+ṭha swā māṃ/ yang g.yon skor gyis song ste byang sgo'i thad nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni/ pū dza karma ni/ āt+ma nāṃ ni r+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī/ āt+ma lā ma ye badz+ra karmā ku ru māṃ/ yang g.yon skor gyis song ste nub sgo'i thad nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī/ pū dza pra warta nā ya/ āt+ma nāṃ nīr+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī/ āt+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ badz+ra dharma pra wartā ya maṃ/ yang g.yon skor gyi song ste lho sgo'i thad nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī/ pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya/ āt+ma nāṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga (179)ta bī ra yo gi nī/ āt+ma rū pi ni/ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ de rnams kyis phyi 'jug grub/ gnyis pa nang 'jug gi sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa la bzhi las/ dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs gyur te// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// gsum pa phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ dung zhal gyi chur nang mchod btab pa byin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ bzhi pa rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyi bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma dam pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams skyil krung mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dang*/ (180)lus drang por bsrang*/ lta stangs nam mkha' la gtod/ rig pa hur bton te/

skad cig gis khyed rang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sngon po phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi zla g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i gdan la lhan skyes yab yum sku shin tu phra ba/ cang te'u dang dril bu 'khrol ba/ gar mdzad cing nam mkha' la gzigs nas pheṃ gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ nyi ma bye ba du ma las kyang ches cher 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis sa gsum gyi dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad bsdus te spyan drangs nas byon pa rnams khyed rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug /dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams la char babs pa ltar sib sib thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod cig / spos rol ḍā dril dang bcas te yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying bzhi'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru kā bid+ma he bid+yā rā dza ya dhī ma he swā hā/ zhes mang du bzla/ de ltar ye shes phab pa de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir mig mig ras dang bcas te dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la ltos la kha dog gang mthong ba de nga la smros shig / ces smras pas lan du/ sna tshogs mthong*/ rang rang gis gang mthong lan gsol/ de'ang dkar pos zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ sngon po dang nag pos drag po/ ljang gu dang khra bos phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// de nas slob ma lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i phyir bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal pho brang mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag

/bsod nams (181)ji lta de ltar shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// de yi bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /de nas dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba ni/ 'di na dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa yin cing*/ de'ang gtso bo'i ye shes kyi rnam rol las rgyud tha dad pa'i gtso 'khor med kyang sngon nas las kyis 'brel ba'i rigs de la 'bab par gyur cig snyam du yid kyis bsam pa sngon du 'gro bas dngos su phyag gi me tog gi phreng ba rin po che'i phreng ba rin thang brjod pa dang bral bar gyur pa gtso bo'i dbu'i rgyan du phul pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad de me tog gi dkyil 'khor du phul mdzod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ/ de nas mig dbye ba ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje ye shes kyi thur mas khyed rang gi ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥprām̐/ zhes mig ras dbye/ de nas/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// nga ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma'i rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon sum gyur// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas/

zhes pa nas/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan dang bcas pa ni rten dang*/ brten pa lha ni gdan dbus ma'i steng du (182)bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog / ces pa nas/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yab kyi pang du bcom ldan 'das ma/ zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid do// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ shar du bud+dha he ru ka nas/ bdud rtsis gang ba re re gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i bar la thig rtags can gyi tshig rnams dor ba brjod nas/ gtso bo yab kyi sku'i gnas rnams dang thugs kar yang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs drug cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa/ de rnams brten pa lha ste dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pas dad gus dga' spro rgya cher skyed mdzod/ de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i skor yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa lags/ gnyis pa zhugs pa la mngon par dbang bskur ba la dbang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang la thun mong ba phyi dkyil gyi dbang dang*/ khyad par ba lus dkyil gyi dbang gnyis kyi// dang po la bum dbang drug bskur ba dang*/ mtha' rten rjes gnang bdun bya ba'o// de dag las dang po zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /de nas bum dbang gi slad du dbang stegs rin po che'i khri dang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du khyed rang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba he ru ka'i cha byad thams cad rdzogs pa'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha bla ma he ru ka dang rigs lnga yab yum/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma grub thob (183)kyi tshogs dang bcas pa nye bar bskul cing spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi dbul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// sogs dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med cing*// sogs dang*/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bskrad/ sems dpa' dang sems ma rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po phab/ dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ rig ma rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ bla ma brgyud pa'i grub thob rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang rnams bskur bar mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la bum dbang drug las/ dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang ni/ slar dkyil 'khor la phul ba'i me tog gtso bo'i dbu rgyan du gnas pa de bla ma he ru kas blangs te khyed rang gi spyi bor bcings te dbang thams cad las snga ba me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur zhing bla mas me tog gang la phul ba'i lha la bos nas/ sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// slob ma 'di rab gzung bar mdzod// ces brjod de dbang bskur bas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rigs nges par byas shing der 'tshang rgya ba'i bag chags khyad par can bzhag cing*/ dbang de las skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā pa la/

zhes me tog mgor bzhag / de nas badz+ra he ru ka'i chu'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de la bla ma he ru ka yab (184)yum dang*/ dbang lha dpag tu med pa rnams kyis gtso bo mi bskyod he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa'i chu spyi gtsug tu blugs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sogs yab yum gyi snying po nye snying bzhi dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas / shri ye hūm̐/ zhes btung du gzhug cing kha rgyan gyis slob mar 'thor/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa me long lta bu'i ye shes su gnas gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las spyi gtsug tu rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rat+na he ru ka'i dbu rgyan gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de la bla ma dang dbang lhas rat+na he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi dbu rgyan cod pan dang bcas pa dbu la bcings te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gis dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin bar bya// oṃ shrī rat+na he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī rat+na ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mtha' rten du bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa/ sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su gnas gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma gyen du lud pa las rna ltag g.yas par rdo rje nyi mas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas pad+ma he ru ka'i rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de la bla ma dang dbang (185)lhas pad+ma he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje phyag g.yas su byin te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur te// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ shrī pad+ma he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mtha' rten du bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas dngos po la 'jug pa'i yid so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su gnas gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las ltag par pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gis dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas karma he ru ka'i dril bu'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang las kyi he ru ka ljang nag sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de la bla ma dang dbang lhas karma he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi dril bu phyag g.yon du byin te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ shrī karma he he ru ru kaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/

oṃ shrī karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mtha' rten du bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'am 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su gnas gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pa rdo rje rgyal pos dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bud+dha he ru ka'i ming gi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de la bla ma dang dbang (186)lhas bud+dha he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi rdor dril mgo thog tu dkrol cing de'i rang bzhin gyi ming btags pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems ma dang sgros 'dzin ma// gnyis med gnyis min rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// oṃ shrī bud+dha he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī bud+dha ā bhi ṣin+tsa hūm̐/ mtha' rten du bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa

sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas ming gzhi chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su gnas gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dpral bar de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar rig pa'i dbang lngas nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs nas ye shes lnga'i ngo bo he ru ka lnga bsgom pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa mtha' rten rjes gnang byed pa la bdun las/ dang po gsung gsang sngags kyi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la yab yum gyi snying po nye snying rtsa sngags rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzod/ byas nas sgrub thabs ltar sngags rnams rjes zlos bya/ de ltar byas shing phreng ba mgrin par bzhag pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas gsung gi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// rtsa ba'i rig pa yang dag ldan// nyi shu rtsa gnyis sngags kyi ni// snying po'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// slar yang sngags rnams bzla/ gnyis pa thugs brtul zhugs kyi dbang la/ he ru ka'i brtul zhugs kyi slad du khyed rang dpal he ru ka yab yum du bskyed pa la rdo rje dril bu gtad de (187)brtul zhugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal bas stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha i ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ gsum pa spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi slad du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ḍā ma rus brgyan pa gru mor gtad/

tshangs skud se ral khar brgyan/ gri gug dang thod pa phyag tu gtad de brtul zhugs byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor dag /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// bzhi pa mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du khyed rang he ru kar gsal ba la mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ e ma/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// sna tshogs rol ba'i 'dod yon rnams// shel la tshon gyi rang bzhin du// sgyu ma lta bur rol par gyis// a la la hoḥrol du gsol// lnga pa rnal 'byor gyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du me long dri ma med pa thogs te gzugs brnyan gyi brdas chos thams cad rten 'byung du ston pa'i mos pa mdzod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med gyis// 'on te rnal 'byor ma'i sras skyes// drug pa 'bras bu la lung ston cing gzengs bstod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas pa dang rdor dril bcas slob ma'i mgor bzhag ste lung ston pa dang lhan cig sangs (188)rgyas thams cad kyis kyang lung ston pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ 'di ltar ngas ni lung bstan te// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// dngos po mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// oṃ shrī he ru ka na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+wāṃ/ bhur+bhu waḥswaḥ zhes lung ston pa ste ma 'ongs pa na gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// bdun pa dbugs dbyung ba ni 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/

khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// rgyal po bdag por bstan pa ste// de ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// de nas sangs rgyas nyid 'thob par// khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin// dbang ni bskur ba tsam gyis ni// slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur// slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis// brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig go// de man chad kyis thun mong ba phyi dkyil gyi bum dbang grub pa lags/ gnyis pa khyad par ba lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur gsan pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar ras yug dmar po res gtod g.yogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po mjal ba'i tshe dbul ba'i ched du me tog gi phreng ba re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kye kye dpal ldan khrag 'thung che// srid pa'i 'ching ba rnam grol mdzod// gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// dam pas bdag nyid rjes bzung mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la slob dpon gyis 'di ltar dris pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsang ba 'dir zhugs khyod kyis ni// dam tshig gsang ba bla na med// bsten cing mchod par khyod nus sam// zhes dris pa'i lan zhus par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan dpa' bos gnang mdzad pa// de dag thams cad bdag bgyid 'tshal// de nas slar (189)yang phyag dgu phrugs su 'tshal zhing gser dang rin po che sna tshogs dang yid 'ong mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig ma rnams phul bar mos la maṇ+ḍal phul// de nas las bum gyi chu 'thor bas chu'i rdul re re bzhin khro bo dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing las bum chu 'thor/ de nas khyed rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du dri'i thig le byas pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes thig le re bya/ khyed rang he ru kar gsal ba la mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas dam tshig sbyin pa ni 'di la ma yengs bar gsan 'tshal/ khyod kyis srog chags gsod par gyis// ma byin par yang len par gyis// pha rol bud med bsten par gyis// rdzun du yang ni smra bar byos// yul kun rtag tu bsten pa dang*// bla na med pa'i dam tshig mchog /'di la nam yang 'da' mi bya// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i slad du lus skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag rlung rang babs su bzhag /sems kyis dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod// khyed rang dpal bde mchog he ru kar gsal ba'i sku lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang thig le rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ dbang po'i sgo brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal mdzod/ de'i thugs kar bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum tshon gang ba/ de'i phyogs bzhir snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi sngo ser dmar ljang ḍa ma ru'i sgra sgrogs bzhin par g.yon du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi gnas gsum dang*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas byang sems dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs kyi sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan gyi rnam (190)par kha ba babs pa ltar byon cing thim pas/ lus kyi rtsa gnas kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bro 'khrab gar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

badz+ra dzñā na ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes bzla zhing spos rol ḍa dril bya/ de nas phyag gi me tog de bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar phul ba'i mos pas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad de phyag tu phul mdzod/ oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phul ba'i me tog de slar yang khyed rang gi spyi bor bcings te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod// oṃ pra ti gṝh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ de nas ma rig pa'i ling tog mig ras dang lhan cig phyes pas dag pa rdo rje mig thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥpram̐/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes blta bar bskul nas/ gang la blta bya'i dkyil 'khor ni slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bo sogs gnas nyer bzhir dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi dang*/ dbang po'i sgo brgyad du sgo mtshams brgyad dang bcas rtsa rlung thig le rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa thams cad mthong ba'i mos pas dad gus dang dga' spro rgya cher skyed mdzod/ ngas 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams grub pa lags/ zhugs pa la mngon par dbang bskur ba la dngos dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ngo sprod pa dang gsum las/ dang po dbang bskur pa'i slad du/ khyed rang 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar dbus su bde mchog he ru ka dang*/ phyogs bzhir snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ mtshams bzhir gser gyi bum pa bzhi bcas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang*/ spyi bo sogs gnas nyer bzhir dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ dbang po'i sgo brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas bzhugs pa slar yang gsal thob mdzod/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i he ru ka'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ dgu spros te/ khyed rang gi thugs ka'i lha (191)lnga/ mtshams kyi bum pa dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas thig le dgur gyur/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dpal lhan skyes yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ mtshams kyi bum pa bzhi dang bcas par gyur/ de bzhin du bla ma'i gnas nyer bzhi'i thugs dang gsung dang sku dang dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnams las rim bzhin hūm̐ dang āḥdang oṃ rnams bcu drug re dang*/ hūm̐ brgyad rnams spros te slob ma'i lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi dang dbang po'i sgo brgyad kyi lha rnams la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas thig le re rer gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dpa' bo dang dpa' mo nyer bzhi// sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas par gyur/ de nas bla ma dang dbang lha nam mkha' gang ba lhan cig pas ka pā la byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba khyed rang gi spyi bor blug cing dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ thod chang dang bum chu bsnon pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum rdo rje'i gnas las byung*// ye shes bla na med pa yi// byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes btung ba dang 'thor ba'ang bya/ zhes btung zhing bkrus pas ye shes kyi khams bde ba chen po'i ye shes su gyur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las slob ma he ru kar gsal ba dang*/ thugs ka'i gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rigs bzhi so so dang*/ sku 'khor la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gsung 'khor la pad+ma gar dbang dang*/ thugs 'khor la he ru ka dang*/ phrin las kyi 'khor lo sgo mtshams ma brgyad la rdo rje rgyal po rnams kyis dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa la bde ba chen pos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bla ma dang khyed rang gi snying ga'i lha rnams dang gnas nyer bzhi'i lha rnams bde ba chen por snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis/ sa gsum gyi (192)dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs te slob ma'i gnas so so'i lha rnams la bstims pas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor byas shing bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing spos rol ḍa dril bya/ gnyis pa rang bzhin byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khyed rang gi thugs ka'i gtso bo lhan cig skyes pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad dpal lhan cig skyes pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu yab yum du gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags bzla zhing spos rol bya/ gsum pa ngo sprad pa ni/ chos thams cad lhan cig skyes pa/ skye ba med pa sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'gag pa med pa gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gnas pa med pa thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dbye ba med pa ye shes kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid gdod ma nas yin pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs par mdzod cig /des phyi bris pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje dang sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba gsan pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// ji ltar che ba'i che sbyin ltar// bdag cag bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la gsang dbang bskur ba'i slad du bla ma dpal bde mchog he ru ka dang*/ rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i nor bur oṃ dang bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' oṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur āḥyis (193)mtshan pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/

'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems dang lhan cig tu zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par babs pas dga' ba'i ye shes skyes/ de nas snying gar babs pas mchog dga'i ye shes skyes/ de nas lte bar babs pas khyad par gyi dga' ba'i ye shes skyes/ de nas gsang bar babs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes/ de ltar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rten du gyur pa'i bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems dkar po/ mngar gsum gyi skyob dang bcas pa'i thod pa'i bdud rtsir bsres pa lcer bzhag ste gsang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can// yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ zhes pas byin pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas/ a hoḥm hā su kha hoḥ/ zhes gsung zhing btung bar mdzod/ de ltar btung ba des lus thams cad khyab pas gsal stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod la cung zad mnyam par 'jog par mdzod/ des nang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kun+da lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje dang longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ skyabs med skyob pa skyabs med skyabs// 'khor lo sdom pas bdag la skyobs// rgyu med par yang thugs rje che// mgon med mgon (194)bdag bka' drin stsol// bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar// gtso bas bdag kyang de 'drar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying pa bdag la skyob mdzod cig

/ces lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la 'di ltar dris pa'i mos pa mdzod// bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar gnas bud med kun// gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang*// gnyis med tshul gyis rab sbyor bas// dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam// smros shig dpa' bo bde ba che// zhes dris pa'i lan gsol bar mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig kun// bdag gis legs par bsten par bgyi// zhes lan gsol ba la mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i rig ma'i lag pa g.yas pa khyed rang gi g.yon par slob ma dang rig ma'i srin lag gnyis bla mas rdo rje dang bcas pas bsdams te sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por byas nas gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya bzang mo 'di nyid ni// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*// dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun// bha ga'i pad+mar tsum+ba nis// bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsgrub par bya// deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis// brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis//

zhes sbyin/ de nas khyed rang dpal bde mchog he ru ka dang*/ zhes pa nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes/ zhes pa'i bar gong gsang dbang ltar dang*/ slar yang rlung 'pho ba med pa hūm̐ gi gdangs can gyis byang sems gyen du bzlog ste gsang gnas nas lte bar slebs pas dga' ba/ de nas snying gar slebs pas mchog dga'/ de nas mgrin par slebs pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/ de nas spyi bor slebs pas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ byang sems des lus thams cad khyab pas lus sems thams cad bde cham gyis song*/ de ltar bde ba chen po de yul can du byas te yul chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bde stong spros pa'i mtha' (195)thams cad dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs par mos pas bde stong dbyer med la cung zhig mnyam par 'jog par mdzod/ des gsang ba shes rab ma'i gsang ba'i reg bya'i dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje dang chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bde chen po// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin can// rdo rje sems dpa' mi 'gyur ba// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi// dbang bskur bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa la bla mas tshig gis ston par byed pa ni// rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs su spang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i rnam rtog dor// mchog tu mi 'gyur rnal 'byor pas// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa la khyed rang lus rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun mdzod/ sems ma bcos par zhog la/

'di ltar snang zhing srid pa'i shes bya thams cad yul rdo rje phag mo dang*/ yul can rang rig pa'i ye shes he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid rtogs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod la cung zhig mnyam par 'jog par mdzod/ des yang gsang don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /don dam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje dang ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i dam tshig bsgrag pa la/ dang po bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig ni/ nangs par sngar langs sems (196)bdag nyid// ma lus lus la byas nas kyang*// bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa// 'dod pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo// lus dang srog la ltos med par// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin du bslab par bya// gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring sogs nas brtsams te// zla ba re rer bsrungs nas ni// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// sha dang chang sogs gang yang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med par ni gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod// spyod pa grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig ni// gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la// 'dod pa lnga ni spyod par gyis// gnyis med la gnas zas la ni// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs bdag /gnyis med pa dang gos pa med// dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod pa bya// zhes dang*/ sher dbang dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig ni// sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyod cing*// tshangs par spyod pa'ang de bzhin no// khro ba med pa'i rgyun sbyong ba// sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung*// rtag tu sgrub la gnas pa ni// yul kun la ni rnam rol cing*// gnyis med grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma// mi brnyas srog ni ji srid bar// bu khyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cig

/ces dang*/ dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig ni// bsam pa thams cad rab tu brtags// bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gnas// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med pas// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// de (197)nas dbang bzhi pa dang rjes su 'brel bar rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// ces lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ skad cig gis seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri lha'i gos sna tshogs kyis nye bar bkab cing rgyab yol dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa dang nyi zla'i gdan la khyed rang bde mchog he ru ka'i rnam par gyur ba sngags 'dis bkod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra sa ma ya s+t+wāṃ/ de'i dbu'i steng du gdugs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du 'phan dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan du ma dang*/ mtha' skor du rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis pa'i rtags rdzas brgyad sogs mchod pa'i tshogs du ma dang bcas par gyur/ de la skad cig gis dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar byon pa dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rgyal srid du dbang bskur ba ltar bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ bum chu sbyin cing kha rgyan gyis 'thor/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/
