dri ma dag /bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas de la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mnga' gsol ba phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'khor lo thod pa rna rgyan dang*// mgul rgyan gdu bu ska rags dang*// do shal dang ni rnam pa bdun// phyag rgya yi ni dbang bskur ro// zhes bskon/ de nas dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun (198)gyis bsngags pa yi// rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs ldan pa'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa yā mi/ zhes bskon/ de nas de la sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum byin te rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi sbyin pa la/ dang po thugs kyi dam tshig tu rdo rje phyag g.yas su byin te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ gsung gi dam tshig tu dril bu phyag g.yon tu byin pas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi sgra sgrogs par mos la dkrol zhing dkur brten mdzod/ aḥ/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// dharma dhā tu aḥ/ zhes sbyin/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa ma ti dzñā na bī ras ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dkrol du gzhug / sku'i dam tshig tu khyed rang dpal bde mchog he ru kar gsal ba rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde bas dgyes par mos la rdor dril thugs kar bsnol te sku'i sgo nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa re mdzod/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su brjod// dam tshig yid ni brtan pa gang*// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// slar yang rdor dril phyag g.yas g.yon du byin te slob dpon du rjes su gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rdo rje rab mchog rdo rje ni// che dang dril bu chen po zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// deng nas khyod kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad smin par bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur/ rgyud shod/ phrin las dang ye shes ma lus bsgrubs shig /de ltar slob dpon du dbang bskur ba la mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes pa nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ me tog 'thor te/ mnga' bdag chen po sku mdog sngon po (199)rgyal gyur cig /dmar po ji ltar mdzes par byas pa rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig mchog gis rgyan gyis mdzes pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor lo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /dang po'i sangs rgyas kun mchog gnas pa rgyal gyur cig /'dod pa thar pa nor dang chos sbyin rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dgyes par rol pa'i rang bzhin rgyal gyur cig /phyag na rdo rje bde ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ de nas phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba ni// glegs bam gtad pas khyod kyis thabs sna tshogs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mos mdzod/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor// pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de rnams ni rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'o// de dang rjes su 'brel bar rjes su gnang ba la bdun las/ dang po gar ni/ kun gyis pad kor sogs gar cung zad bsgyur bar mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo'i tshogs// shes rab thabs kyis snyems chen gyis// gsang mchog bde ba'i dga' ston gyis// gnyis pa ni/

phreng ba sbyin cing rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod// sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba zung*// sangs rgyas kun gtso rnal 'byor ma// de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// phreng ba 'di ni rgyan yin no// gsum pa glu ni/ snyan pa'i 'gyur khugs dang bcas te rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ lus can rnams la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya// des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// bzhi pa mig thur ni/ gser gyi mig thur gyis mig sman mig la byug cing ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod// ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib (200)bsal ba ltar// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥprām̐/ lnga pa ni/ dud dkar byin te chos 'chad pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// drug pa ni/ las bzhi'i dbyibs bcos pa'i tsakli btegs la/ phrin las bzhi po rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gdon tshogs dag /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// bdun pa ni/ grub pa brgyad kyi gzugs bris pa'i tsakli btegs la/ thun mong gi grub pa brgyad po rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// rkang mgyogs mi snang ril bu bcud// mkha' la spyod pa'i dngos grub kun// thams cad ci dgar bsgrub par gyis// zhes brjod/ de nas de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la srung sdom ci nus su bgyid snyam pa'i srung sems nan tan du bskyed nas dam tshig mdor bsdus te khas len pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// dbang legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rgyal srid ltar sprul nas 'bul na cha shas re re nas so sor bzhes te longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de de nas brtsams te bdag dran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de ltar de nyid kyi sgo nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub thob chen po tai lo pa dang nā ro pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur gyi rim pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa phul grub pa lags pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ de ltar (201)gsan pa'i rnam dkar gyis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo ba'i 'dun pas bsngo smon mdzad 'tshal/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bgyis te slob ma rnams gyes par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs mchod sogs kyi gong du lag mchod bya ba ni/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i thod pa'i bdud rtsi mdun tu bzhag /g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis zeg ma gtor la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa brjod/ g.yon skor gyis zlum skor bya zhing*/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ g.yon skor gyis chos 'byung 'bri la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yas skor du bris te/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ dbus su/ hūm̐ bam̐/ phyogs bzhir/ mam̐ lam̐ pām̐ tām̐/ rnams las gtso bo yab yum dang mkha' 'gro bzhi/ zur drug la/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐ heḥ/ phaṭa haṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yam̐/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes yab yum gyi go cha'i lha rnams bkod tshul thig le bya/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog bde ba chen po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su gsal bar gyur/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun chang gtor la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he 'i sngags brjod / oṃ swā bhā wa sa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yon skor du zlum skor bya ba dang chos 'byung bsnol ma dbus kyi sa bon lnga po sngar ltar g.yas pas bkod pa la/ thig le lnga po yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum bde chen gyis rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su gsal bar gyur// oṃ shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba bī ra yo gi ni ār+ghaṃ

nas / shab+da 'i bar dang / a mṛ ta ma taṃ gi rnams sbyar ba'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a las zla ba'i steng du dbyangs yig dkar po shes rab kyi rang bzhin/ g.yon par mam̐ las nyi ma'i steng du gsal byed so bzhi dmar po thabs kyi rang bzhin/ steng 'og gi yi ge las 'od zer dkar dmar 'phros te thod pa'i nang du song bas (202)gnyis su med par 'dres shing khol nas ma dag pa phyir lud/ rlangs pa'i 'od zer mchod sprin du gyur pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mnyes par byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slar yang lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil dang g.yon gyi mdzub mo lnga dang sen mo rnams la/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa haṃ yab kyi go cha'i dpa' bo drug dang*/ g.yon pa'i mthil du oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa las yum gyi go cha'i lha mo drug gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gan+dhe/ ni wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lha thams cad phan tshun yum gyis yab la 'khyud/ yab kyis yum la 'khyud/ thal mo kha sbyar la/ yab yum gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar babs pas bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ slar yang lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa gnyis kha sbyar ba 'og tu blta ba'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du lan gsum dkug / oṃ ā:hūm̐/ zhes brjod la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis phyi rol dang*/ mchod rdzas dang rang nyid rnams la gtor zhing*/ gnas dang rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams srung ba mtshams kyi gur khang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mas gtams par gyur/ bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la smin mtshams nas steng 'og rim bzhin du 'thor nas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/

te lo shes rab bzang po/ na ro dzñā na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang 'dir phung khams rgyal ba yab yum nyid// yul dbang sems las dbang yul khro mo dpa'// srid gsum dbyer med lhan skyes rnal 'byor mchod// ces rang gi lus kyi lha tshogs mchod cing*/ rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams// bdud rtsi'i rgyun (203)gyis gus pas rab mchod na// rjes su brtse bas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki mī dzā la sam+ba raṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying po rgyas bsdus gang rung gi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul/ shrī ma hā kā la oṃ ā:hūm̐/ shrī ma hā kā li oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ lag mchod chang des tshogs gtor rnams la bran dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa gtor ma zur du byed na/ mchod gtor bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams la gong ltar sngags lan gsum res 'bul/ phyi nang gsang gsum mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs na de tsam gyis chog /gtor mgron gsar du spyan drangs na bzod gsol byas la gshegs su gsol lo// gsum pa tshogs mchod ni stag lpags la sogs pa'i steng du chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su tshogs gtor dang sha chang gtso bor gyur ba'i tshogs rdzas ji tsam 'byor ba bsham/ bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/

ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi= phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ tshogs nyid spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bla ma rnams bzhengs shig /bka' brgyud bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// hūm̐ bzhengs shig yi dam rnams bzhengs shig /bde mchog yab yum sku bskyod 'tshal// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi= hūm̐ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams bzhengs shig /ma mgon (204)lcam dral da bskyod 'tshal// dam tshig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi= gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// 'dir 'tshogs rnam 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// de nas tshogs rdzas bstab pa ni/ /hūm̐ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas la// zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// 'dir 'tshogs rnams la stsal du gsol// hūm̐ gsang ba'i dur khrod gnas brgyad nas// grub thob pho mo 'khor bcas la// zag med sogs 'gres / hūm̐ chos dbyings bde ba chen po nas// 'khor lo bde mchog 'khor bcas la// zag med= hūm̐ o rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas// gsang ba ye shes 'khor bcas la// zag med= hūm̐ shar phyogs gsang ba'i dur khrod nas// mkha' 'gro yab yum 'khor bcas la// zag med= /hūm̐ byang phyogs gsang ba'i dur khrod nas// lā ma yab yum 'khor bcas la// zag med=

/hūm̐ nub phyogs gsang ba'i dur khrod nas// dum skyes yab yum 'khor bcas la// zag med= /hūm̐ lho phyogs gsang ba'i dur khrod nas// gzugs can yab yum 'khor bcas la// zag med= hūm̐ gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas la// zag med= hūm̐ 'jig rten sna tshogs dur khrod nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas la// zag med= hūm̐ bdud 'dul chen po'i pho brang nas// ye shes chos skyong 'khor bcas la// zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// 'dir 'tshogs rnams la stsal du gsol// skabs 'dir gong du smos pa ltar gtor chog gis gtor ma 'bul/ grub na mkha' (205 )'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma'ang btang*/ phrin las bcol ba'i rjes su skong rdzas dngos 'byor yid sprul bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs la/ hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas rnams// tshogs dang gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang ngo tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// zhes gong ltar tshang bar sbyar/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas rnams// gsan cing bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig dbang gis ni// sku gsung thugs dang ci 'gal ba// mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// zhes snga ma'i go rim ltar sbyar/ las rdor gyis/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan sogs kyis tshogs drang*/ rin thang med las sogs kyis blangs la nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas rol/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la bdud rtsis bran/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlab / hūm̐/ gzhan yang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma// shin tu 'jigs pa'i keng rus gzugs// yan lag rus pa'i 'khor los brgyan// snying khrag rngub cing rkan sgra sgrogs// rkang mgyogs brtul zhugs gdug rtsub can// dam tshig can gyi las mkhan yin// dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gcod yin// phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes// dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan ba srungs// da res nyul la mel tshe mdzod// hūm̐/

'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can// srin po'i lus la ce spyang gdong*/ sbrul nag lce la spyan mig glog /kha rlangs dug la nga ro 'brug /mi lpags g.yab mo phyogs bcur rdeb// rgyu zhags 'dom dgus dgra bo 'ching*// khros pa'i smin phrag ser chen 'bebs// bye ba dung phyur sa ma ya// ba spu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar// dam tshig can gyi sogs / hūm̐/ sha za'i mkha' 'gro yang sprul tshogs// yi dwags lus la dur bya'i gdong*// chu srin rkan la thod pas brgyan// lus la rnag khrag chu ser (206)lhags// smre sngags tshig la ngu 'bod dbyangs// phyi nas 'dre 'tshub sprin bzhin ldang*// bkra mi shis shing rjes ngan gtong*// ro langs rkang pas dur khrod nyul// phung sri lag pas srog rtsa gcod// gza' srin mig gis zla tshes blta// dam tshig sogs / hūm̐/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs// las la myur zhing bstan pa srung*// lce spyang mang po rol du khrid// bu chung lus la bya rog gdong*// bshugs glu'i dbyangs la smre sngags tshig /ri gsum 'grim zhing lung gsum bskor// chu la zhon nas grib so 'grim// dkyil 'khor mtha' ma bskor zhing nyul// dam tshig can sogs / oṃ uts+tshi ṣ+ṭa ba l+yā di bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ de nas rdo rje'i glu len pa ni/ pad+ma la ni rdo rje gnas// pad+ma nyid ni zhing yin no// rgyun tu cang te'u brdung bya ste// snying rjes ku co bsgrags mi bya// da ru stobs ldan 'bad par bya// chang ni mang po btung bar bya// grogs po skal ldan gzhug par bya// skal pa med par rnam par spang*// bzhi mnyam gla rtsi sih+la// ga bur rnams kyis byug par bya// der ni tshod ma sha chen gyis// bkang ba yang dag bza' bar bya// 'gro dang 'ong ba 'gog mi bye// dag dang ma dag bsam mi bya// rus pa'i rgyan gyis lus la brgyan// de ru ro ni gzhug par bya// 'dus phyir gnyis ni sbyor bar bya// der ni reg min spang mi bya//

zhes brjod/ bzhi pa gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs bya/ sgrub mchod skabs sogs su chu bzhi nyer spyod/ rig ma bcu drug bcas tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ bka' brgyud bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas gus mchod 'bul/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ cho ga dkyus ma tsam la/ bsdu na/ chu bzhi nyer spyod/ rig ma bcu drug bcas sngags tsam dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta sa nang mchod / ma taṃ gi sa gsang mchod 'bul / chos (207)dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pa tsam gyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ lnga pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// sogs dang he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ drug pa gshegs bsdu ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor ye shes pa ras bris sogs la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med na gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par mos/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis bsrung bar mos/ spyi bor oṃ ha dkar po sogs go cha'i dpa' bo drug bkod pa dang*/ sum+bha ni sa phyogs mtshams srung ba ni bde mchog spyi ltar bya'o// bdun pa bsngo smon shis brjod bya ba ni/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu

sogs sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ shis pa brjod pa ni me tog 'thor la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi sku la legs gnas pa'i// bka' brgyud rin chen thugs rje'i mdzad phrin dpag yas kyis// 'gro rnams zag med bde chen dbyings la 'god mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings la legs 'byung zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo phyogs bzhi'i zhal la gzigs// pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng ba rnam par mdzes// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// byang chub sems dang tsan+dan gur gum dri chen chu// dag pa'i snod mchog dga' ba'i (208)reg pas rnam par spyod// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig sa bla sa steng sa 'og tu// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phreng skor gnas dang nye ba'i gnas// zhing dang nye zhing 'du dang nye 'dur dpa' bo rol// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig phyogs bzhi dag dang mtshams rnams su// khwa gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'ong gzugs gnyis ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun// yongs rdzogs rin chen gzhal yas rta babs 'dod snam dang*// rgyan dang bkod pa sna tshogs dag gis mngon mdzes pa// bden pa= bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams su// ri dang mchod rten chu shing me dang sprin rnams la// grub ba lha klu zhing skyong rnal 'byor ma rnams rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog / ces dang*/ sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog

/ ces sogs brjod la mtha' rgyas su bya'o// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig /rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// byin rlabs chu rgyun chad med legs byon pa// thos pa'i skal bas rang blo yongs su tshims// bka' babs grub chen ma ti rat+na'i gsung*// brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bslad pa med pa ru// bkod pa'i dge bas snyan brgyud rin po che'i// bstan pa dar zhing bde ba mchog 'grub shog /ces pa'ang gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad kyi khrid srol rnams kyi smin byed kyi gtso bo bde mchog snyan brgyud che 'bring chung gsum bzhugs su gsol ba'i skabs/ rgyal dbang karma bka' brgyud kyi gral mthar 'khod pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos zur mang snyan brgyud kyi rtsa ba dang gsal byed yig cha rnams kyi dgongs don sor bzhag ste rang lo gya bdun pa la dpal spungs yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub sder bkod pa'i yi ge ba ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
